paragraphs.text: The latest addition is [[e250-mrna-de-dier-zhanchang-duihua-yingbo-chaijie-moderna-renlei-shouge-zhongliu-yimiao-sanqi-tupo-73a69583-98ee-43d6-a892-3e7c93012dd9|E250｜mRNA的第二战场：对话英博，拆解Moderna人类首个肿瘤疫苗三期突破]], a [[SiliconValley101|硅谷101]] episode with [[YingBo|Ying Bo]] of [[AiboShengwu|爱博生物]] on [[Moderna]] and [[Merck]]'s [[InterPath001]] individualized mRNA melanoma-vaccine readout. It adds [[YingBo]], [[AiboShengwu]], [[InterPath001]], [[BioNTech]], [[IndividualizedCancerVaccineManufacturing]], [[NeoantigenSelectionTradeoff]], and [[RecurrenceFreeSurvivalEndpoint]], while extending [[IndividualizedCancerVaccine]], [[CancerVaccinePlatform]], [[CancerImmuneRecognitionProblem]], [[TumorMicroenvironment]], [[AIClinicalValidationInDrugDiscovery]], [[Moderna]], and [[Merck]]. Its core synthesis is that the phase 3 RFS signal is a stronger platform validation than short cancer-vaccine headlines, but the public meaning still depends on postoperative melanoma fit, PD-1 comparator benefit, undisclosed HR/subgroups, OS and approval follow-through, CMC/QC, automation, cost, and access. No settled contradiction is recorded; the episode qualifies earlier optimism by moving the topic from cancer-vaccine promise to a validation-bound manufacturing and endpoint problem.

The latest addition is [[689-a-murderous-affair-the-habsburgs-greatest-scandal-part-1-glt6194086702|689. A Murderous Affair: The Habsburgs' Greatest Scandal (Part 1)]], a [[TheRestIsHistory]] episode that backfills the prehistory for [[690-a-murderous-affair-death-at-mayerling-part-2-glt7203783068|Part 2]] of the Mayerling sequence. It adds [[PrincessStephanieOfBelgium]], [[ElisabethMarieOfAustria]], [[GeorgVonSchonerer]], [[AustroHungarianDualMonarchy]], and [[DynasticHeirRoleEntrapment]], while extending [[CrownPrinceRudolf]], [[MaryVetsera]], [[FranzJosephI]], [[EmpressSisi]], [[AustriaHungary]], [[HabsburgDynasty]], [[CountessLarish]], [[MayerlingIncident]], [[KaiserWilhelmII]], [[Vienna]], [[TheRestIsHistory]], [[MayerlingDeathPact]], and [[FinDeSiecleViennaCrisisReading]]. Its core synthesis is that Mayerling is not only a final locked-room scandal: Rudolf's harsh dynastic formation, blocked liberal politics, failed marriage, illness, Vienna's modern-but-strained culture, the dual monarchy's nationalities pressure, and Mary's mediated access all precede the death-pact and suppression problems. No settled contradiction is recorded; psychological causation, medical claims, Mary's agency, and Habsburg-decline readings remain source-scoped.

The latest addition is [[vol-214-weishenme-yue-youxiu-de-ren-yue-rongyi-zai-zhichang-bei-pua-dao-huaiyi-ziji-cong-tiequan-jiaoyu-liaodao-tiequan-zhichang-lmx4ewrw7kvcqpyh-q3bur35ybgz|VOL.214 为什么越优秀的人，越容易在职场被PUA到怀疑自己？从《铁拳教育》聊到“铁拳职场”]], a [[ZheBingShuoLaiHuaChang|这病说来话长]] episode with [[Atang|阿汤]] and Seoul psychiatrist [[NanJiHe|南基贺]] using [[TrueEducationKDrama|《铁拳教育》/《真教育》]] to connect school violence, parent-teacher pressure, and workplace bullying. It adds [[NanJiHe]], [[TrueEducationKDrama]], [[WorkplaceBullying]], [[StructuralPowerImbalance]], [[PsychologicalBoundaryProtection]], and [[ParentalProjectionControl]], while extending [[Atang]], [[ZheBingShuoLaiHuaChang]], [[WorkSelfWorthBoundary]], [[WorkplaceRelationshipBoundaries]], and [[PsychologicalAbuseRecognition]]. Its core synthesis is that the realistic "iron fist" is not retaliatory violence: victims should identify asymmetrical power, separate boss or parent judgment from self-worth, reduce self-blame, preserve evidence, talk with others or clinicians, and use institutional channels where available. No settled contradiction is recorded; Korean complaint pathways, drama scenes, and psychological techniques remain source-scoped rather than legal or clinical advice.

The latest addition is [[zizhi-tongjian-hanji-856-lishi-gaosu-ni-ren-ruo-xinluan-zhenjiao-zi-luan-lo7m-9mz-pvstxtfgavrne4bszks|《资治通鉴·汉纪》856丨历史告诉你：人若心乱，阵脚自乱]], a [[RuiqiJiangtouZizhiTongjian|芮淇讲透资治通鉴]] episode backfilling the 162 CE [[EmperorHuanOfHan|汉桓帝]] frontier-and-Jingzhou layer before [[zizhi-tongjian-hanji-857-xuehui-gongying-cai-shi-zhenzheng-de-yingjia-lh3zx6pw-4ib7owiz8c68bv-9htn|Hanji 857]] and [[zizhi-tongjian-hanji-858-weishenme-quan-ni-yiding-yao-huanwei-sikao-lobr-xznqo-ctjpc-ytpstubmahl|Hanji 858]]. It adds [[MaMuLateHan|马睦]], [[LiuDuLateHan|刘度]], [[LiSuNanCommanderyLateHan|南郡太守李肃]], and [[HuShuangLateHan|胡爽]], while extending [[HuangfuGuiLateHan|皇甫规]], [[FengGunLateHan|冯绲]], [[YingFengLateHan|应奉]], [[DuShangLateHan|度尚 / 杜尚]], [[RootCausePacification|查因安抚式治理]], and [[StrategicEmotionConcealment|情绪不外露的战略纪律]]. Its core synthesis is that late-Han crisis command first depends on internal composure and credible repair: Huangfu Gui restores a diseased army and impeaches abusive officials before Qiang surrender, while Ma Mu, Liu Du, and Li Su show panic becoming flight and violence; Feng Gun models another path through financial self-protection, Ying Feng's local knowledge, reward refusal, and credit allocation. No settled contradiction is recorded; Li Su is disambiguated from the later Lü Bu/Niu Fu actor and ASR forms are normalized against the received text.

The latest addition is [[zizhi-tongjian-hanji-857-xuehui-gongying-cai-shi-zhenzheng-de-yingjia-lh3zx6pw-4ib7owiz8c68bv-9htn|《资治通鉴·汉纪》857丨学会共赢，才是真正的赢家]], a [[RuiqiJiangtouZizhiTongjian|芮淇讲透资治通鉴]] episode backfilling the Huan-era [[HuangfuGuiLateHan|皇甫规]] accusation and reward-gatekeeping layer before [[zizhi-tongjian-hanji-858-weishenme-quan-ni-yiding-yao-huanwei-sikao-lobr-xznqo-ctjpc-ytpstubmahl|Hanji 858]] and [[zizhi-tongjian-hanji-859-gudai-haoren-weishenme-nan-dang-haoguan-llkyx18ssvserxncvrtkw7xfduad|Hanji 859]]. It adds [[ZuoGuanLateHan|左悺]], while extending [[HuangfuGuiLateHan|皇甫规]], [[XuHuangLateHan|徐璜]], [[EmperorHuanOfHan|汉桓帝]], [[FengGunLateHan|冯绲]], [[GuiyangCommanderyLateHan|桂阳郡]], [[MilitaryRewardEunuchGatekeeping|宦官门槛下的军功赏罚]], [[MeritBasedRewardPunishment|因功赏罚]], [[PalaceAccessMonopoly|宫廷接触垄断]], [[CourtFeedbackCollapse|君臣反馈失灵]], and [[GoodIntentionsPoliticalLimits]]. Its core synthesis is that late-Han merit and ordinary relationships both require reading the actual interest structure: Huangfu can defend the fiscal logic of frontier pacification, but Xu Huang and Zuo Guan can still make expected reward contingent on gift/apology channels and turn refusal into renewed slander. No settled contradiction is recorded; account figures, Zhang Feng, Li Yan, Wuling Man unrest, and the workplace "共赢" advice remain source-scoped.

The latest addition is [[zizhi-tongjian-hanji-861-shenme-yang-de-ren-kancheng-laoshi-kaimo-lu0kadsc9aetzip9cedyv01wndrh|《资治通鉴·汉纪》861丨什么样的人堪称老师楷模？]], a [[RuiqiJiangtouZizhiTongjian|芮淇讲透资治通鉴]] episode backfilling the 164 CE [[GuoTaiLateHan|郭泰]] mentorship layer immediately before [[zizhi-tongjian-hanji-862-ta-yin-yiju-hua-xiuqi-zuizhong-shenbai-minglie-lrvklai847fvlp1l28coofzgbsyq|Hanji 862]]. It adds [[MengMinLateHan|孟敏]], [[YuChengLateHan|庾乘]], [[WeiZhaoLateHan|魏昭]], [[ZuoYuanLateHan|左原]], [[SongChongLateHan|宋冲]], [[XuZhiLateHan|徐稚]], and [[MoralMentorshipTalentCultivation|人师型人才成全]], while extending [[GuoTaiLateHan|郭泰]], [[HuangYunLateHan|黄允]], [[ShentuPanLateHan|申屠蟠]], and [[SituationalCharacterTests|五观识人法]]. Its core synthesis is that a teacher-model forms people rather than only transmitting learning: Guo Tai notices capacity in ordinary or low-status scenes, tests steadiness under pressure, treats fault as corrigible, and accepts limits when office or public repair exceeds his power. No settled contradiction is recorded; ASR forms such as 深图潘, 宇城, 左员, 徐志, 黄云, and 范胖 are normalized to received late-Han names.

The latest addition is [[zizhi-tongjian-hanji-862-ta-yin-yiju-hua-xiuqi-zuizhong-shenbai-minglie-lrvklai847fvlp1l28coofzgbsyq|《资治通鉴·汉纪》862丨他因一句话休妻，最终身败名裂]], a [[RuiqiJiangtouZizhiTongjian|芮淇讲透资治通鉴]] episode backfilling the 164 CE reputation and local-governance layer before [[zizhi-tongjian-hanji-863-yi-ba-huo-shaochu-de-zhandouli-ljpfmj8pphunruioce64ywjk7yhb|Hanji 863]]. It adds [[HuangYunLateHan|黄允]], [[JinWenjingLateHan|晋文经]], [[FuRongLateHan|符融]], [[QiuXiangLateHan|仇香]], [[ChenYuanLateHan|陈元]], [[WangHuanLateHan|王奂]], and [[EmptyReputationRealityGap|空誉违实]], while extending [[GuoTaiLateHan|郭泰]], [[ParentalExpectationShame|父母期望羞耻化]], and [[HumaneLocalGovernance|仁厚地方治理]]. Its core synthesis is that reputation and education both need grounded evidence: Huang Yun and Jin Wenjing show how fame can outrun conduct and distort appointment judgment, while Qiu Xiang shows local moral teaching repairing a family complaint without punitive escalation. No settled contradiction is recorded; transcript forms such as 袁伟, 金文金, 芙蓉, 仇湘, and 王焕 are normalized to received late-Han names.

The latest addition is [[vol-215-di-gi-fengmi-ling-zhetang-kangtangwan-zhejie-kongtangren-daodi-caile-duoshao-keng-ft-dashihua-ltb5lyaycaxoijiktbo4pxne2a5z|VOL.215 低GI蜂蜜、零蔗糖、抗糖丸…？这届控糖人到底踩了多少坑？ft.「大食话」]], a [[ZheBingShuoLaiHuaChang|这病说来话长]] episode with [[Atang|阿汤]] and [[YueWanrou|岳宛柔]] from [[DaShiHua|大食话]] on sugar-control literacy. It adds [[PracticalSugarControl]], [[FoodPleasureEngineering]], [[AddedFreeSugarDistinction]], [[LiquidSugarRisk]], [[LowGIMarketingTrap]], [[NutritionLabelSugarTraps]], [[SweetenerUncertainty]], and [[GlycationSkinAnxiety]], while extending [[LifestyleWeightManagement]], [[MedicalRiskManagement]], and [[LifestyleDiseasePrevention]]. Its core synthesis is that sugar control should reduce high-risk forms and misleading claims rather than demonize all sweetness or staple foods: liquid sugar, juice, hidden sugar, zero-sucrose labels, low-GI honey, sweeteners, and anti-sugar pills all need context around food structure, total intake, frequency, and qualified care. No settled contradiction is recorded; the episode keeps diabetes, fatty liver, metabolic disease, dermatology, and supplement claims source-scoped rather than individualized medical advice.

The latest addition is [[essentials-using-meditation-to-focus-view-consciousness-expand-your-mind-dr-sam-harris-scim7293799235|Essentials: Using Meditation to Focus, View Consciousness & Expand Your Mind | Dr. Sam Harris]], a [[HubermanLab]] Essentials episode with [[AndrewHuberman]] and [[SamHarris]] on meditation, consciousness, the felt self, non-dual mindfulness, emotional loops, psychedelics, and ordinary freedom. It adds [[SamHarris]], [[MDMA]], [[NonDualMindfulness]], and [[PsychedelicOrdinaryFreedom]], while extending [[HubermanLab]], [[AndrewHuberman]], [[ImpermanenceAndNoSelf]], [[AwarenessMeditationStoryDropping]], [[TotalAttentionPractice]], [[EmotionRegulationToolkit]], [[RuminationVsReflection]], and [[NoBetterLife]]. Its core synthesis is that meditation is not only stress reduction or concentration: Harris frames the apparent observer as another appearance in awareness, treats thoughts and emotions as workable when seen clearly, and subordinates psychedelic peak states to freedom available in ordinary waking life. No settled contradiction is recorded; the source's meditation, no-self, psychedelic, and emotion-regulation claims remain philosophical, experiential, and context bounded.

The latest addition is [[your-top-health-questions-answered-scim2882548864|Your Top Health Questions Answered]], a [[HubermanLab]] solo Q&A with [[AndrewHuberman]] on sleep, circadian light, memory, smell training, fertility, perimenopause, surgery recovery, and career direction. It adds [[SustainableHealthOptimization]], [[MorningLightCircadianAnchoring]], [[SelfTestingMemoryPractice]], [[OlfactoryTraining]], [[FertilityEnergyAvailability]], [[PerioperativeCircadianRecovery]], [[PassionDiscoveryThroughEngagement]], and [[ApprenticeshipBeforeOriginality]], while extending [[HubermanLab]], [[AndrewHuberman]], [[AcetylcholineFocusSupport]], [[SleepAsDailyHealthAccount]], [[MemoryConsolidationWindows]], [[PerimenopauseBrainMetabolism]], [[MenopauseClinicalSharedDecision]], and [[PassionTrapCareerAdvice]]. Its core synthesis is that practical health self-regulation works through flexible fundamentals rather than protocol perfection: morning light, sleep, exercise, nutrition, recovery, and learning routines should fit real constraints, while supplements, fertility, testosterone, hormone therapy, and surgery recovery remain source-scoped and clinically bounded. No settled contradiction is recorded; the Q&A strengthens existing sleep, menopause, learning, and career pages without replacing their medical or evidence boundaries.

The latest addition is [[vol-216-tingzhi-shenhua-qianeye-bie-rang-wangluo-reci-biancheng-nide-zhenduanshu-lp0cll17cydzmh36sawfj7-rjwur|VOL.216 停止“神化”前额叶：别让网络热词变成你的诊断书]], a [[ZheBingShuoLaiHuaChang|这病说来话长]] episode with [[Atang|阿汤]] and [[XueXiaofan|薛小凡]] on online prefrontal-cortex claims, self-control, dopamine, ADHD, sleep, hunger, and diagnosis boundaries. It adds [[XueXiaofan]], [[PrefrontalCortexOverattribution]], [[StateDependentSelfControl]], [[ADHDSelfDiagnosisBoundary]], and [[ClinicalBehaviorChangeRedFlags]], while linking [[MedicalKnowledgeBoundary]], [[MedicalRiskManagement]], [[MedicalDiagnosticReasoning]], [[NeuromodulatorStateToolkit]], [[DopamineInvertedU]], [[MotivationRewardEffortCalculation]], [[SleepAsDailyHealthAccount]], [[EmotionRegulationToolkit]], [[AttentionCapacitySelection]], and [[ProcrastinationSelfRegulationFailure]]. Its core synthesis is that the prefrontal cortex matters but should not become a universal blame object: everyday impulse, distraction, emotional lapses, and late-night consumption often depend on bodily state, environment, learned cues, and network-level brain function, while persistent or worsening behavior and cognition changes require qualified care. No settled contradiction is recorded; the source qualifies simplified brain-region, dopamine, ADHD, and 25-year-old maturity claims as source-scoped rather than diagnostic.

The latest addition is [[essentials-how-to-become-resilient-forge-your-identity-lead-others-jocko-willink-scim2090153799|Essentials: How to Become Resilient, Forge Your Identity & Lead Others | Jocko Willink]], a [[HubermanLab]] Essentials episode with [[AndrewHuberman]] and [[JockoWillink]] on discipline, identity, leadership, resilience, detachment, and action after adversity. It adds [[JockoWillink]], [[DisciplineOverMotivation]], [[OperationalDetachment]], [[LeadershipEmotionalCounterweight]], and [[ActionAfterAdversity]], while extending [[HubermanLab]], [[AndrewHuberman]], [[AutonomicStressTraining]], [[MotivationRewardEffortCalculation]], [[EmotionRegulationToolkit]], and [[AttentionCapacitySelection]]. Its core synthesis is that self-command becomes practical when action is decoupled from current motivation, bodily discomfort is used as bounded training, leaders counterbalance group emotion, and detachment widens attention before decision. No settled contradiction is recorded; exercise, nutrition timing, battlefield, parenting, leadership, and resilience claims remain source-scoped and not medical or universal protocols.

The latest addition is [[vol-218-hanjie-yisheng-shijian-hou-sida-menzhen-tanbaiju-bu-duili-bu-shuaiguo-yihuan-ruhe-lianshou-daying-fang-louzhen-de-paileizhan-lgbs8aaxguh-xzga8iuewwc7ypvm|VOL.218韩杰医生事件后四大门诊坦白局：不对立不甩锅，医患如何联手打赢防漏诊的“排雷战”？]], a [[ZheBingShuoLaiHuaChang|这病说来话长]] episode with [[Atang|阿汤]], [[YaMengDoctor|亚萌]], [[JiangYuliangDoctor|蒋宇亮]], [[YinXinDoctor|银欣]], and [[MaHaoning|马浩宁]] on first-visit uncertainty, missed diagnosis, and follow-up. It adds [[Atang]], [[YaMengDoctor]], [[JiangYuliangDoctor]], [[YinXinDoctor]], [[DiagnosticSafetyNetting]], [[MissedDiagnosisRisk]], and [[SecondOpinionStrategy]], while extending [[ZheBingShuoLaiHuaChang]], [[MaHaoning]], [[MedicalDiagnosticReasoning]], and [[DoctorPatientCommunication]]. Its core synthesis is that "observe for now" only works as care when paired with a safety net: suspected diagnosis, still-unexcluded dangers, return or emergency triggers, report tracking, and qualified second opinions keep medical uncertainty from becoming abandonment. No settled contradiction is recorded; the episode keeps overtesting, pathology, imaging, alternative medicine, and health-product claims bounded by clinical context.

The latest addition is [[essentials-how-to-optimize-female-hormone-health-for-vitality-longevity-dr-sara-gottfried-scim5131677929|Essentials: How to Optimize Female Hormone Health for Vitality & Longevity | Dr. Sara Gottfried]], a [[HubermanLab]] Essentials episode with [[AndrewHuberman]] and [[SaraGottfried]] on female hormone health across adolescence, reproductive adulthood, contraception, PCOS, perimenopause, and midlife cardiometabolic risk. It adds [[SaraGottfried]], [[LisaMosconi]], [[FemaleHormoneHealthPhenotyping]], [[PCOSCardiometabolicRisk]], [[OralContraceptiveInformedConsent]], [[PerimenopauseBrainMetabolism]], and [[CoronaryArteryCalciumMidlifeScreening]], while extending [[HubermanLab]], [[AndrewHuberman]], [[WomensHealthDiagnosticGap]], [[MenopauseClinicalSharedDecision]], [[MenopauseInformationTriage]], [[ContinuousGlucoseMonitoring]], and [[CardiovascularBrainHealthLink]]. Its core synthesis is that women's hormone health is best read as a life-course phenotype shaped by family history, trauma, stress physiology, sex hormones, thyroid, gut function, micronutrients, insulin, glucose, symptoms, and reproductive history rather than a single protocol. No settled contradiction is recorded; oral contraceptive, testing, chronic-cardio, hormone-therapy, CGM, and coronary-calcium claims remain source-scoped and clinically individualized.

The latest addition is [[neuroscience-of-emotions-tools-for-improving-emotion-regulation-dr-ralph-adolphs-scim1222961716|Neuroscience of Emotions & Tools for Improving Emotion Regulation | Dr. Ralph Adolphs]], a [[HubermanLab]] episode with [[AndrewHuberman]] and [[RalphAdolphs]] on emotion, behavior, psychology, neuroscience, social perception, body signals, and regulation. It adds [[EmotionsAsFunctionalControlStates]], [[EmotionalGranularity]], [[CognitiveReappraisalEarlyIntervention]], [[AutonomicStressTraining]], [[AmygdalaFearDissociation]], [[SocialEmotionInferenceLimits]], [[BrainBodyEmotionMapping]], [[EmotionAttentionalCapture]], and [[TaskSwitchingResidue]], while extending [[EmotionRegulationToolkit]], [[HubermanLab]], and [[AndrewHuberman]]. Its core synthesis is that emotions are functional control states useful for decision and motivation rather than single brain regions or only conscious feelings; practical regulation therefore means monitoring, differentiating, reframing early, shaping environments, respecting body-state evidence, and managing transition costs. No settled contradiction is recorded; AI-emotion, cold-exposure, endurance, solitude, meditation, amygdala, facial-expression, and body-map claims remain source-scoped or under-tested.

The latest addition is [[vol-219-shipin-boke-dangdai-nianqingren-yaotu-zijiu-zhinan-guke-yisheng-jiaodi-bieba-nide-yao-dang-xiaohaopin-lkvjq45dukdjpesxikwec0zrglmg|VOL.219视频播客｜当代年轻人腰突自救指南：骨科医生交底，别把你的腰当消耗品！]], a [[ZheBingShuoLaiHuaChang|这病说来话长]] episode with [[MaHaoning|马浩宁]] on [[LumbarDiscHerniation|腰椎间盘突出]], spine imaging, surgery thresholds, and rehabilitation. It adds [[ZheBingShuoLaiHuaChang]], [[MaHaoning]], [[LumbarDiscHerniation]], [[SymptomDrivenSpineCare]], [[LumbarNeutralPosition]], and [[SpineRehabilitationProgression]], while linking to [[MedicalDiagnosticReasoning]], [[DoctorPatientCommunication]], and [[MedicalRiskManagement]]. Its core synthesis is that lumbar-disc care has to join structure and symptoms: report language such as protrusion or degeneration is not a standalone treatment order, while severe pain, numbness, motor weakness, bowel or bladder dysfunction, recurrence risk, and tissue-healing limits decide when rest, rehabilitation, clinical review, or surgery becomes urgent. No settled contradiction is recorded; the source keeps posture, massage, heat/cold, exercise, and surgical choices bounded by clinical context.

The latest addition is [[essentials-how-to-access-your-creativity-rick-rubin-scim7816635332|Essentials: How to Access Your Creativity | Rick Rubin]], a [[HubermanLab]] Essentials episode with [[AndrewHuberman]] and [[RickRubin]] on creativity, attention, feedback, finishing, self-doubt, and meditation. It adds [[CreativityAsFeltProcess]], [[CreativeApertureShift]], [[ArtisticFeedbackBoundary]], [[CreativePhaseSeparation]], [[SubconsciousCreativeIncubation]], [[SelfDoubtAsCreativeCheck]], and [[AwarenessMeditationStoryDropping]], while extending [[HubermanLab]], [[AndrewHuberman]], [[RickRubin]], [[EmbodiedTaste]], [[AttentionCapacitySelection]], [[FocusedDiffuseThinkingBalance]], [[RestorativeCreativePacing]], [[ExternalFeedbackSelfCalibration]], [[TotalAttentionPractice]], and [[MeditativeStabilityPractice]]. Its core synthesis is that creative work is not only inspiration or discipline: Rubin treats it as felt attention, direct testing, protected taste, alternating focus and release, phase-specific deadlines, proportionate doubt, and awareness of the stories the mind adds. No settled contradiction is recorded; the episode's creativity, subconscious processing, meditation, live-performance, and surgery-healing claims remain source-scoped.

The latest addition is [[tech-20260827-0827-mp-tech-pod-128-tech-20260827-0827-mp-tech-pod-128|Why 70mm Film Still Feels Like the Hottest Movie Technology]], a [[MarketplaceTech]] episode with [[MilesWilliams]] on the [[AlexTheatre]]'s 70mm retrofit for [[ChristopherNolan]]'s [[TheOdyssey]]. It adds [[AlexTheatre]], [[MilesWilliams]], [[SeventyMillimeterFilmProjection]], and [[AnalogMoviegoingExperience]], while linking [[IMAX]], [[AnalogMediaPreservation]], [[PhysicalVideoMediaRevival]], [[VideoStoreCulture]], and [[CustomMoviePopcornBuckets]]. Its core synthesis is that century-old projection can become a current technology draw when format geometry, scarce equipment, old parts, specialist labor, historic venue memory, and release-window demand reinforce one another. No settled contradiction is recorded; the source's revenue ranking, Gen Z analog-interest claims, and projection-apprenticeship signals remain source-scoped.

The latest addition is [[how-to-improve-motivation-overcome-procrastination-dr-masud-husain-scim3386045656|How to Improve Motivation & Overcome Procrastination | Dr. Masud Husain]], a [[HubermanLab]] episode with [[AndrewHuberman]] and [[MasudHusain]] on motivation, apathy, dopamine, attention, selfhood, addiction, ADHD, and aging. It adds [[MasudHusain]], [[MotivationRewardEffortCalculation]], [[ApathyActionInitiation]], [[DopamineInvertedU]], [[AttentionCapacitySelection]], [[CognitiveResilience]], and [[SelfConceptPlasticity]], while extending [[HubermanLab]], [[AndrewHuberman]], [[DopamineWantingLoop]], [[ProcrastinationSelfRegulationFailure]], [[ModifiableDementiaRiskFactors]], [[AgeAdjustedDementiaDecline]], [[AlzheimerDrugEfficacyGap]], [[AttentionFragmentation]], [[MindBodyUnion]], and [[ImpermanenceAndNoSelf]]. Its core synthesis is that motivation is not a character label or a dopamine slogan: reward, effort, prior learning, attention, task design, social meaning, and basal-ganglia/frontal action circuitry all shape whether wanting becomes action. No settled contradiction is recorded; medication response, ADHD diagnosis, stimulant performance, attention training, and Alzheimer-risk claims remain source-scoped.

The latest addition is [[essentials-diet-nutrition-for-mental-health-dr-chris-palmer-scim2465421786|Essentials: Diet & Nutrition for Mental Health | Dr. Chris Palmer]], a [[HubermanLab]] Essentials episode with [[AndrewHuberman]] and [[ChrisPalmer]] on nutrition, ketogenic diets, epilepsy history, and metabolic psychiatry. It adds [[HubermanLab]], [[AndrewHuberman]], [[ChrisPalmer]], [[RussellWilder]], [[MayoClinic]], [[NutritionMentalHealth]], [[MetabolicPsychiatry]], [[KetogenicDietMentalHealth]], [[KetogenicDietEpilepsyEvidence]], [[MitochondrialMentalHealthModel]], [[PsychiatricMedicationSupervisionBoundary]], and [[CarbohydrateRestrictionMentalHealth]], while linking to [[MedicalRiskManagement]], [[MitochondrialTherapy]], and [[DietaryConstraintProductInsight]]. Its core synthesis is that nutrition can be a clinically meaningful psychiatric variable, especially when ketogenic interventions reach ketosis, but the psychiatric evidence remains source-scoped and safety-bounded: serious disorders, medication changes, and high ketone targets require professional supervision, and the mitochondrial mechanism is a unifying hypothesis rather than settled proof. No settled contradiction is recorded; the source distinguishes century-old epilepsy use from still-developing mental-health trials.

The latest addition is [[700-the-troubles-bloody-sunday-part-4-glt3909829334|700. The Troubles: Bloody Sunday (Part 4)]], a [[TheRestIsHistory]] episode extending the [[TheTroubles]] sequence from post-[[InternmentWithoutTrial|internment]] collapse into [[BloodySunday]], [[NorthernIrelandDirectRule]], failed 1972 IRA talks, and [[BloodyFriday]]. It adds [[BloodySunday]], [[BloodyFriday]], [[FreeDerry]], [[WillieWhitelaw]], [[SavilleInquiry]], [[WidgeryInquiry]], and [[NorthernIrelandDirectRule]], while extending [[NorthernIreland]], [[Derry]], [[Bogside]], [[Stormont]], [[BritishArmy]], [[ProvisionalIRA]], [[UlsterDefenceAssociation]], [[EdwardHeath]], [[BrianFaulkner]], and [[CounterinsurgencyLegitimacyTrap]]. The Ruiqi Zhouji sequence now ties early Warring States power to institutional execution and political afterlife. Wei's post-Guiling problem is not only military, because [[QinEastwardPressure|Qin pressure]] at Anyi and Guyang forces diplomatic repair; Han's [[ShenBuhai|申不害]] branch shows [[LegalistRulerTechnique|Legalist technique]] as ruler self-restraint over appointments and rewards; and Qin's reform branch moves state capacity into [[Xianyang|capital location]], [[HouseholdSeparationLaw|households]], counties, land, measurement standards, war incentives, and fiscal extraction. The Shang Yang death sequence adds that effective institutional control does not automatically produce [[PeopleBasedPoliticalSecurity|social support]] for the reformer: [[PowerExitTrap|exit traps]], [[WarringStatesReformBacklash|reform backlash]], and [[TextualVariantPoliticalStakes|source-wording stakes]] become part of the same Qin state-building story. Across [[MeritBasedRewardPunishment]], [[QinAdministrativeStandardization]], [[ShangYangReforms]], and [[LegalistSelfBindingBackfire]], "Legalist" governance in these sources is a set of enforceable controls over territory, status, family space, information, violence, and ruler discretion rather than one abstract doctrine.

The late Qinji sequence now extends that state-building story from conquest capacity into post-conquest imperial identity. [[zizhi-tongjian-qinji-120-1-shui-shi-huangdi-zhong-de-mabaonan-lhw8vsj6ta6rjdkugcvfohaqqxc0|Qinji 120-1]] shows Qin turning victory over [[QiState|齐国]] into a [[ConquestSelfDefenseNarrative|self-defense narrative]], while [[zizhi-tongjian-qinji-120-2-qinchao-di-yi-tao-vi-sheji-linian-lno-aeljks2vt1k3wjrizsanirtq|Qinji 120-2]] shows the next layer: [[QinShiHuang|嬴政 / 秦始皇]] builds a new imperial vocabulary and water-virtue symbol system through [[ImperialSymbolicStandardization|帝国符号标准化]], tying [[YinYangFivePhasesPoliticalTheory|five-phase legitimacy]], [[PosthumousNamePolitics|abolished谥法]], [[QinAdministrativeStandardization|standardization]], and [[LegalistRulerTechnique|law-and-punishment technique]] into one package.

[[78-xifang-juedou-shi-chujian-ba-weile-rongyu-687731000]] adds a Western dueling branch to the wiki's law, honor, and violence material. It adds [[XifangJuedouShi|《西方决斗史》]], [[JohnGideonMillingen]], [[HonorDuelCulture]], [[JudicialDuel]], [[TrialByOrdeal]], [[ChivalricTournamentCulture]], [[ProceduralizedViolence]], [[WeaponTechnologyDuelLethality]], [[FemaleDuelAgency]], [[AndrewJackson]], [[AaronBurr]], [[AlexanderPushkin]], [[EvaristeGalois]], [[RichardBrinsleySheridan]], [[JulieDAubigny]], and [[HenryIIOfFrance]], while extending [[MihuanChishu]], [[NapoleonBonaparte]], [[AlexanderHamilton]], [[PowerViolenceDistinction]], [[PrivateRevengeModernLaw]], and [[FemaleSelfPossession]]. Its core synthesis is that dueling was a brutal honor practice, but also a revealing institution: societies tried to turn insult, uncertain truth, social rank, and reputation into rule-bound combat before modern law, evidence, and public procedure fully displaced that logic.

The Le Guin source adds an anthropological science-fiction branch to the wiki's literary and political material. [[36-heian-de-zuoshou-liufang-yu-ai-de-weilai-wangshi-605254522]] connects [[UrsulaKLeGuin|Ursula K. Le Guin / 厄休拉·勒古恩]], [[TheLeftHandOfDarkness|《黑暗的左手》]], [[Gethen|格森星 / Gethen]], [[GenlyAi|金利·艾 / Genly Ai]], [[Estraven|伊斯特拉凡 / Estraven]], [[Karhide|卡海德]], [[Orgoreyn|欧格瑞恩]], and [[Ekumen|艾库曼]] to [[AmbisexualWorldbuilding]], [[AnthropologicalScienceFictionWorldbuilding]], [[ShifgrethorPoliticalFace]], [[CorrectQuestionEpistemology]], [[PatriotismAsHatred]], and [[IntimacyBeyondGenderScript]]. Its core synthesis is that Le Guin's alien planet is not only a gender premise or a diplomatic plot: it is a method for asking better questions about sex, state loyalty, exile, propaganda, trust, and love when familiar categories fail.

The Zheng Yuanjie source extends the wiki's childhood-literature branch into public-institutional satire. [[FeimaPaiQiche|《飞马牌汽车》]] shows that a children's story can reason like organizational analysis: a reasonable safety rule becomes [[SafetyAsControl]] and [[RuleIdolatry]] when no accountable exception is possible; officials then produce [[BureaucraticAbsurdityEscalation]] by creating meetings, agencies, devices, and representative layers; and the unresolved traffic jam becomes [[ProblemIndustrialization]] when services, fees, prestige, and jobs attach to the stuck state. The source also sharpens [[AntiAuthoritarianEducation]] through [[XunTuJi|《训兔记》]], where obedience is not virtue by default but a training system that can erase judgment.

The Kundera source adds a compact modern-literature branch through [[12-man-dang-milan-kundela-yi-ju-zhengjing-meiyou-549335675]] and [[SlowKundera|《慢》]]. [[SlownessAsModernityCritique]] connects speed to bodily disappearance and slowness to recovered experience; [[PublicMoralPerformance]] turns televised charity and intellectual argument into a public-stage problem; [[KitschAsWasteDenial]] and [[AntiLyricism]] explain why crude body comedy matters aesthetically; and [[AuthorAsPoliticalSymbol]] keeps [[MilanKundera|Kundera]]'s [[CzechRepublic|Czech]] history, exile, privacy anxiety, and contested biography visible without reducing the fiction to politics alone. The source's durable synthesis is [[PoliticalConditionAsHumanExperiment]]: politics, media, speed, and exile are conditions that expose human vanity, fear, courage, desire, and self-mythologizing.

The Okamoto Kanoko source extends the wiki's literature branch from familiar childhood classics and zhiguai archives into modern Japanese short fiction that resists plot extraction. [[BuddhistLifeAffirmingLiterature]] gives the source its tonal distinction: [[LaoJiChao|《老妓抄》]] can hold loneliness, aging, desire, and futility without becoming despair. [[SubtlePlotPsychologicalAftertaste]] and [[GenderedPatronageInversion]] also sharpen existing reading and gender frames by showing that quiet fiction can make money, dependence, age, and unfinished aspiration visible through relation rather than thesis.

The Peter Reinhardt [[TheSocialRadars]] source adds a bridge between early-YC software learning and climate hard-tech execution. [[OpenSourceWedge]] makes the [[Segment]] story more specific than a generic pivot: a small open-source utility became a company only after [[HackerNews]] response, user requests, hosted workflow control, pricing discovery, and [[SalesAsLearnableSkill]] turned attention into [[ProductLedWillingnessToPay]]. The [[CharmIndustrial|Charm Industrial]] half extends the carbon-removal branch beyond [[DirectAirCapture]] through [[BioOilCarbonRemoval]], where biomass sourcing, transport distance, underground injection, [[CarbonStoragePermanence]], [[CarbonRemovalPermitting]], and [[AdvancedMarketCommitment|advanced market commitments]] decide whether removal can move from high-intent procurement into lower-cost scale.

The interesting link to the existing synthesis is market formation: [[LowCarbonConstructionMaterials]] may become easier to source when California's code makes demand visible, extending [[EconomicClimateTechAdoption]] from cheaper customer value into regulation-backed supplier confidence.

[[StateCryptoReserves]] extends [[Bitcoin]], [[DigitalGold]], and [[BitcoinSafeHavenBehavior]] into state balance sheets: officials may want an asset that behaves differently from stocks and bonds, but no state has yet proven that a Bitcoin reserve works during fiscal stress. [[PublicCryptoInvestmentRisk]] and [[SeparateCryptoReserveFund]] keep the taxpayer-risk question visible, while [[SeizedDigitalAssetCustody]] shows that [[Arizona]]'s model is closer to preserving digital property than making a fresh investment bet.

[[HumanAuthorshipPremium]] links [[GenuineFred]]'s human-designed label to [[ColleenKirk]]'s research on lower trust, authenticity, purchase intent, and word of mouth when consumers believe AI authored a product, advertisement, communication, or artwork. Its most reusable distinction is not AI versus no AI, but authorship order: [[AIAssistantAugmentation]] is more acceptable when the human develops the work and AI assists, while AI-led work can trigger [[AlgorithmAversion]], [[AIAuthorshipPresence]] concerns, and [[AIContentDevaluation]] in emotionally meaningful or identity-linked categories.

The April 6 [[MarketplaceTech]] source adds a child-safety law branch to the wiki's platform-governance material. [[CaliforniaAB1709]] shows one regulatory route: keep children under 16 off social media through an access ban modeled on [[Australia]]. [[AaronMackey]] and the [[ElectronicFrontierFoundation|Electronic Frontier Foundation]] supply the counterframe: minors still have [[YouthOnlineSpeechRights]], age gates can create [[SocialMediaAgeGateSpeechBurden]] for adults as well as children, and [[ComprehensiveConsumerDataPrivacy]] can target collection and targeting practices without broadly blocking lawful communication. The durable synthesis is that social-media harm regulation has to distinguish product-design liability, platform editorial defenses, user speech rights, and privacy-law business-model reform.

[[planet-money-vs-the-nbas-tanking-problem]] connects [[SportsTanking]], [[SportsDraftIncentiveDesign]], [[DraftLotteryTradeoff]], [[DraftWheel]], [[GoldPlan]], [[NoDraftPlayerMarket]], [[SportsCompetitiveBalance]], and [[SportsPlayerAutonomy]] through the [[NationalBasketballAssociation|NBA]], [[ProfessionalWomensHockeyLeague|PWHL]], and [[NationalWomensSoccerLeague|NWSL]]. Its core contribution is that bad sports incentives are not just bad sportsmanship: draft rules can make losing rational, and every repair shifts costs among weak teams, fans, owners, small markets, and incoming players.

Its main contribution is to join wonder with responsibility: a speculative dinosaur can remain thrilling while still being imagined through fossils, birds, enclosure constraints, dirty work, stress signals, and the ethical question of what this animal needs.

The Thiel source adds a Silicon Valley politics branch to the wiki's existing Trumpism and technology-power synthesis. The Marketplace Tech fire-rebuilding source adds a house-scale adaptation branch. Earlier wildfire material in the wiki emphasized [[FireTechClimateResilience]] as a market around detection, suppression, utilities, insurance, home hardening, and institutional buying; [[tech-20260112-0112-mp-tech-pod-128-tech-20260112-0112-mp-tech-pod-128]] shows the homeowner-material layer through [[CrossLaminatedTimber]], [[FireResistantBuildingEnvelope]], [[ConcreteFilledWallSystems]], [[ThreeDPrintedHousing]], and [[BiophilicDesign]]. The resulting synthesis is that [[ClimateAdaptation]] is not simply a harder shell: a rebuilt home has to negotiate future fire, construction speed, embodied carbon, cost, permitting, neighborhood character, and the emotional continuity of a lost place.

The Bibi election source extends the wiki's institution-and-legitimacy thread across politics, sport, and climate. [[IsraeliElection2026]] shows electoral legitimacy under strain when voters can judge wartime leadership but parties may avoid the [[PalestinianQuestionInIsraeliPolitics]]. [[SportsPoliticalInterference]] shows that even a successful expanded [[FIFAWorldCup]] can be remembered for host-country pressure on rules. [[IcebergClimateSymbolism]] shows how climate meaning attaches to concrete objects such as [[A23A]] when natural cycles, ecological ambiguity, and warming-sea anxiety become hard to separate.

The folk-tale mystery source extends the wiki's literature and folklore material from source-history inquiry into rule-world puzzle design. Earlier folklore pages used [[StoryMotifTransmission]], [[MythicSourceLayering]], and [[EvidenceBoundFolkloreInquiry]] to ask how legends travel, accumulate, or encode social memory. [[SettingBasedMystery]] and [[FolkTaleMysteryRewriting]] ask what happens when those motifs are accepted as operational rules: a magic mallet can become physical evidence, a tiny body can structure an alibi, and animal transformation can turn identity into a fair-play problem.

The Clark Ashton Smith source adds a weird-fiction and Cthulhu branch to the wiki's literary material. [[CthulhuMythos]] is treated as [[OpenSharedMythos]] rather than closed continuity, while [[CosmicHorror]] explains the field's fear of unknown scale, age, depth, and nonhuman priority. Smith's specific contribution is [[HorrorHumorWeirdFiction]] and [[AntiAnthropocentricSatire]]: in [[SevenGeases|《七咒赋》]], [[TheDoorToSaturn|《通往土星之门》]], and the related story summaries, humans are often too small, inconvenient, or already studied to be as important as they imagine. That extends [[AbsurdRationality]] and [[ClassicReadingComplexity]] by showing how apparently pulp or monster-adjacent stories can preserve literary density, procedural comedy, and anti-human-center philosophy.

The Chen Diexian source adds a consumer-industrial history branch to the wiki's business and culture material. [[ButterflyBrand|蝴蝶牌]] shows that a brand moat can be built before contemporary platforms: romance-writer persona, magazine recipes, household chemistry, product naming, trademark design, celebrity image, and [[NationalGoodsBranding]] all create trust and demand. [[VernacularIndustrialism]] also gives the wiki a longer history for later [[ShanzhaiPhones]], [[GlobalProductLocalization]], and [[ChineseHardwareGlobalization]] themes: borrowing and imitation can be exploitative or low quality, but they can also become local repair, cost reduction, raw-material learning, and user-fit innovation.

The Asahi ransomware source adds an operational-security branch to the wiki's existing security and disaster-recovery material. [[AsahiGroup]] and [[SuperDry]] make the point concrete: cyberattacks become business problems when order handling, inventory, logistics, customer service, factories, and [[SAP]]-style ERP systems stop coordinating physical supply. The source's durable concepts are [[RansomwareBusinessContinuity]], [[OfflineBackupRecoveryDrills]], and [[PersonalSecurityTiering]]: prevention matters, but ransom refusal and personal safety depend on recoverable backups, rehearsed restoration, account hygiene, and security spending matched to target value.

The first source argues that effective AI use is shifting from chat prompts toward [[AgenticWorkflow]], where AI systems have persistent context, can call tools, and operate inside real workflows. Its practical core is [[ContextEngineering]] plus [[AISkills]]: models and tools may converge, so durable advantage comes from examples, preferences, criteria, workflows, files, and tacit standards made explicit.

The second source adds a more organizational view through [[Qwen]], [[Alibaba]], and [[LinJunyang]]. It treats open-source model success as strategically valuable but difficult to sustain inside a large company because influence, training cost, ROI, management order, and personal ambition are evaluated through different logics. That tension is captured by [[LargeCompanyOpenSourceStrategy]], [[AICommercializationPressure]], [[LargeCompanyOrganizationalInertia]], and [[StarTalentInBigCompanies]].

The third source turns commercialization pressure toward consumer AI through [[Doubao]] and [[ByteDance]]. It argues that China's [[SoftwarePaymentCulture]] was shaped by years of free internet products, but [[AIInferenceCostStructure]] makes unlimited free AI harder because token generation, GPU capacity, and electricity scale with use. [[AISubscriptionEconomics]] then becomes a balancing act among free access, paid tiers, heavy-user costs, ad limits, and competitor pressure from products such as [[Yuanbao]] and [[DeepSeek]].

EP117 adds the service-entry version of that consumer AI pressure. [[Qwen]] is not presented only as another chatbot; the source argues that [[Alibaba]] needs a consumer assistant because [[AIAssistantServiceEntry]] could reroute users toward whoever controls the assistant layer. [[Taobao]], [[Fliggy]], [[Damai]], [[Gaode]], [[DingTalk]], and [[Quark]] make Alibaba's opportunity different from [[ByteDance]]'s traffic-led [[Doubao]] or [[Tencent]]'s [[WeChat]]/mini-program path, while [[AgenticCommerce]] and [[AgentPermissionBoundaries]] explain why buying, booking, ranking, payment, and refund workflows are harder than search replacement.

The fourth source adds [[Ninety]] as a SaaS operating-system case. Enterprise deployment appears as [[ForwardDeployedEngineer]] work in the first source and is deepened by the [[RollingAI]] source through [[DigitalEmployees]], [[FrontlineAIEnablement]], and [[BusinessLedAITransformation]]; model access only matters when it enters workflows, incentives, systems, and local judgment. The second source shows the same principle through production failures in [[AIAssistedSoftwareDevelopmentRisk]] and through [[HumanJudgmentUnderAI]], where AI can improve preparation but cannot replace fast, situated judgment in live professional settings. The [[HeadlessSoftware]] source adds that products also need agent-callable surfaces; if an agent can execute the work, GUI becomes more important for review and trust than for the core operation itself. The [[Paperboy]] source adds the personal-agent version: agents need [[OSLevelContext]], [[PersistentAgentMemory]], and calibrated [[ProactiveAgents]] before they can become high-bandwidth collaborators instead of prompt-driven tools. The [[Xiaoban]] source adds the physical AI version: a useful model is only one layer inside material safety, motion latency, privacy choices, expressive design, charging rituals, and the user's interpretation of agency. The [[JustinsNutButter]] and [[CatalinaCrunch]] sources add the physical retail version: a liked product still needs production capacity, [[CPGDistribution]], [[InStoreDemos]], [[RetailShelfPlacement]], [[PackagingAsProductExperience]], and [[CPGManufacturingScaleUp]] before demand becomes scalable. The [[Banlatte]] handset source adds the mobile-hardware version: a desired device still depends on network standards, operator channels, chips, factories, after-sales, [[ChinaHandsetSupplyChain]], and [[SmartphoneOperatingSystemEcosystems]]. The [[MiniMax]] source adds the model-builder version: even as [[FrontierModelScaling]] and [[MiniMaxM3]] improve generation, teams still need [[AICodingVerification]], [[DomainExpertAlignment]], and [[ModelHarnessCoEvolution]]. The [[AetherAI]] source adds the causal-robotics version: for physical tasks, capability claims remain weak unless the model can handle hidden variables, distribution shift, and action-conditioned dynamics through [[CausalWorldModels]]. The [[Youju]] source adds the entertainment version: generated content and prototypes matter only if they become stable systems, designed agency, repeatable fun, creator-consumer loops, and social context through [[AIInteractiveEntertainment]] and [[AIGameIndustrialization]]. The [[BairongIntelligence]] source operationalizes the enterprise-deployment thread from a different angle than [[RollingAI]]. The EP127 [[YingdiHaike]] source adds the skills-as-operating-routine version of the same agent branch. The Planet Money prediction-market history source extends the market-governance synthesis backward. [[AcademicPredictionMarketSandbox]] adds a regulatory design lesson: small-stakes research markets can be useful, but commercial successors such as [[Kalshi]] and [[Polymarket]] inherit harder questions about event scope, trader eligibility, insider information, and public trust.

The investment and platform synthesis is that easy software wrappers face pressure from frontier models and agent tooling, but paid AI norms may also create room for focused tools if they solve concrete problems, earn trust, and can be found by customers or agents. [[Doubao]] adds the consumer version of [[ProductLedWillingnessToPay]], [[Baidu]] adds the incumbent version where [[SearchAdvertisingDecline]] and AI answer cannibalization can erode an old profit engine before a new one is proven, [[Xiaoban]] adds a consumer hardware version through emotional product quality and sub-10000 RMB pricing, [[JustinsNutButter]] and [[CatalinaCrunch]] add consumer packaged goods versions through sensory proof, nutrition claims, premium pricing, shelf context, [[TrialSizeProduct]], and [[PackagingAsProductExperience]] behavior, [[AIInteractiveEntertainment]] adds an entertainment version through time, attention, emotional payoff, and repeat play, [[Ninety]] adds the B2B version through AI packages, consumption allowances, organizational data, and possible value-based pricing, [[TeaMaker]] adds a founder-market version through revenue, retention, repeat usage, and users pulling products into existence, [[PeakAI]] adds an AI-search version through measurable channel visibility and mid-market time-to-value, [[Sprinto]] adds a compliance version through externally required trust evidence, [[ThreatLocker]] adds a cybersecurity case through urgent risk reduction and live-environment proof, [[PartyGuitar]] and [[KenanVoiceChanger]] add prototype cases where public excitement still must become real use or purchase, [[MiniMaxM3]] adds a model-provider case through coding capability and token usage, [[StepFun]] adds a foundation-model case through [[AIPlusTerminals]] and the need for a core application with large annual profit, [[RollingAI]] adds a [[ServiceAsSoftware]] case where agents carry service-like business outcomes, [[Paperboy]] adds a personal-agent case where defensibility may come from [[HumanAgentCollaboration]], [[OSLevelContext]], and [[PersistentAgentMemory]], and [[EricRies]] adds that AI-era products still need sustainable [[AIInferenceCostStructure]]. The [[JimSimons]] source adds that investors should separate AI product value from stock-market returns: [[AIInvestmentResearch]] can improve understanding, but [[AIIPOValuation]] still requires discipline around price, cash flow, competition, lockups, and downside tolerance. EP38 adds that even broad index or large-cap exposure can be hit by funding structure, central-bank timing, [[CarryTradeUnwind]], and valuation [[MarketMeanReversion]], so [[InvestmentRiskManagement]] must account for macro mechanics as well as individual security analysis. [[HeadlessSoftware]] adds that products may also need to be reachable through [[AgentFacingInterfaces]], while [[AgenticEconomy]] adds infrastructure opportunities around sandboxes, memory, payments, token supply, and agent networks. More durable opportunities may come from hard domains such as [[AIForScience]], [[AIMaterialsDiscovery]] and [[MaterialsPipelineCompany]] efforts like [[Kaiwuji]], [[EmbodiedAI]], [[WorldModels]], [[CausalWorldModels]], [[CompanionRobots]], [[AssistiveAI]], [[FinancialAIAgents]], vehicles and devices under [[AIPlusTerminals]], AI entertainment and creator products such as [[AINPCSocialInfrastructure]], [[AIInteractiveContentPlatforms]], [[VibeSong]], and [[AI3DPrototyping]], and cybersecurity controls such as [[ZeroTrustSecurity]], from infrastructure and platforms for [[EverythingAgent]], from workflow SaaS with defensible context such as [[Mas]], from distribution-heavy portfolios such as [[TeaMaker]], from CPG brands that combine [[CPGDistribution]] with real product differentiation such as [[JustinsNutButter]] and [[CatalinaCrunch]], from [[BuildingPublic]] channels on platforms such as [[Xiaohongshu]], from AI-search analytics and GEO tooling such as [[PeakAI]], from compliance automation with deterministic evidence such as [[Sprinto]], from security products that combine [[DefaultDenySecurity]] with [[MSPChannelDistribution]], from agent-interface and verification infrastructure, from FDE and service-as-software firms that can deliver measurable business outcomes, from personal-agent products that make memory and proactivity trustworthy, from finance tools that improve explanation without pretending to remove [[InvestmentRiskManagement]], or from personal tools that follow [[DataPortabilityAndSustainableTools]].

EP46 extends the investment synthesis from U.S./macro drawdowns into Chinese A-share bull cycles. EP18 extends the personal-finance synthesis from investing and banking into risk transfer.
